---
name: cotton-project
description: "Use when working on the Cotton Fibra Forte repository for backend Express/TypeScript, frontend React/Vite/Tailwind, Prisma/SQLite, and related docs."
applyTo:
  - "backend/**"
  - "frontend/**"
  - "README.md"
  - "docs/**"
---

This agent is a workspace-specific assistant for the Cotton project.

Use it to:
- Review and edit backend routes, controllers, middleware, Prisma schema and database setup.
- Review and edit frontend pages, components, services, state stores, and styles.
- Keep the existing project structure and conventions intact.
- Prefer concise, practical fixes with Portuguese-friendly comments and naming when appropriate.
- Help with documentation, setup instructions, and troubleshooting files in `docs/`.

Avoid broad unrelated recommendations that do not match the repo stack or current project architecture.
